title: Logo against colourful background

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose a logo color against its actual background because recognition depends on contrast, not on a preferred swatch alone.
strategic_value: Consistent contrast decisions can keep Helsinki’s framed signature visible across its varied palette and photographs.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section separates black and white logo guidance and illustrates color-background combinations with named exceptions.
practical_value: Choose black or white from the background pairing, then verify visibility over photographs.

content_islands.name: General contrast
content_islands.spec: Open with primary black/white usage and photographic background guidance.

content_islands.name: White-logo combinations
content_islands.spec: List exceptions and show white marks on palette fields.

content_islands.name: Black-logo combinations
content_islands.spec: List dark-field exceptions and show black marks on palette fields.

ingredient.name: Black or white framed logo
ingredient.role: Keep the city signature distinguishable from its surroundings.
ingredient.application: Use black on Engel and Silver; use white on Brick, Bus and Coat of Arms; check photographic contrast.
ingredient.scope: Black and white are primary choices. Other logo colors are possible only with careful consideration, so the section does not establish an absolute two-color prohibition.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text repeatedly explains the choices through the logo’s visibility against its background.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples compare marks on colored fields.
reference_purposes.Constraint: White excludes Engel and Silver; black excludes Brick, Bus and Coat of Arms.
